# Help us keep Communicative Tech safe

Help us keep GenAI safe

Every line of code, every analysis, and every insight you bring will help shape a trustworthy future for technology.

[See Open Roles](https://alice.io/careers#open-positions) [Join Our Freelancer Network](https://alice-collective.alice.io/)

## Join us in Wonderland

At Alice, you’ll be part of a team of professionals who are driven by curiosity and grounded in responsibility. Together, we stay one step ahead of emerging risks - so billions of people, and the systems they rely on, can advance unafraid.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/691c0981a0d0e3e75ccd0341_career-icon01.svg)

#### Honesty

The future of communicative technology begins with transparency. We build trust by being accountable and straightforward in everything we do here.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/691c0981167a2300311e764f_career-icon02.svg)

#### Curiosity

Threats evolve and so do we. Curiosity keeps us sharp, pushing us to explore, learn, and uncover what others overlook, so we can stay ahead of tomorrow’s challenges.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/691c0981fabe1181177308d5_career-icon03.svg)

#### Compassion

Safety is human at its core. We lead with empathy, protect with conviction, and driven by the fact that behind every interaction is a real person we’re here to protect.

![Cartoon mouse in blue outfit and hat examining a large paper with lines and dots.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/6a956c2ffdc2a14801f2fa45_Read.svg)![Simplified globe showing continents around the Atlantic Ocean including Americas, Europe, and Africa.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/6a956cbfaad5acd88acbc925_globe.webp)
